doc_requests.documents: Because the account will be funded and operated by your relative, Suzanne-Clémence Dumas, we need to identify and verify her as the beneficial owner before we can open it: (1) a valid government-issued photo ID for Suzanne-Clémence Dumas, and (2) a signed beneficial-owner declaration. Please also note that under bank policy the account should be held by the person who owns and controls the funds, so we may need to discuss the account structure (e.g. Ms Dumas as account holder) once we have these documents.
